props.name: branches
props.description: Elements excluded from "outside" detection (e.g., portaled triggers).

props.name: children
props.type: undefined | null | string | number | bigint | false | true | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: disableOutsidePointerEvents
props.description: When true, pointer events outside the layer are blocked (modal behavior).

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the layer should dismiss (after consumer handlers).

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description: Called on Escape key. Call event.preventDefault() to cancel dismissal.

props.name: onFocusOutside
props.description: Called when focus moves outside. Call event.preventDefault() to cancel dismissal.

props.name: onPointerDownOutside
props.description: Called on pointer down outside. Call event.preventDefault() to cancel dismissal.
